title: observability-weekly-2026-03-16
content:
Week: 2026-03-09 -> 2026-03-15
Owner: Aisha Patel (observability lead)
Attendees: Aisha, Marco, Eleni, Samir, Jin (SRE, joined for cost-telemetry sync)

Summary:
- Focus this week: tracing sampling rollout, dashboard cleanup for support SLOs, initial cost-telemetry pilot for inference routes.
- Progress was steady; main risk is a backlog of dashboard migration tasks that could delay oncall onboarding.

Standup highlights (by person):
- Aisha: Finished sampling policy for websocket services (policy draft in OBS-412). Deployed to staging; saw 25% reduction in trace volume with negligible loss in flamegraph fidelity. Next: run production canary for 48h.
- Marco: Dashboard migration — moved 6 legacy dashboards to new layout (latency-by-route, request-p50/p95/p99). Found inconsistent tag naming causing missing series; raised GH PR #178 to normalize tags.
- Eleni: Alerts tuning for tracing ingestion pipeline. Adjusted alert thresholds after staging canary; lowered false positives from 12/day to ~2/day. Still seeing occasional spikes at 03:00 UTC — investigating background batch jobs.
- Samir: Cost telemetry prototype: exported per-model token-cost metrics into prometheus via exporter. Initial dashboard shows Dedicated pools account for ~68% of inference cost for last 7 days. Working with Jin on billing join to map customer IDs.

Meeting notes: Tracing rollout sync (Mon 2026-03-09)
- Decision: production canary for websocket and api-gateway routes at 10% traffic for 48h. If error budget impacts are <0.1% and flamegraph coverage >=90% of existing traces, expand to 50%. (Owner: Aisha, JIRA: OBS-412)
- Action: Add additional TTL to cached trace chunks to avoid re-ingesting during downstream backfills (Owner: Eleni, GH PR: redwood/observability#182).

Dashboard migration working session (Wed 2026-03-11)
- Resolved tag inconsistencies (service_name vs svc_name) and created a normalization layer in the ingestion pipeline. Patch in PR #178 (Owner: Marco).
- Agreed to retire old dashboards with names prefixed "obs-legacy-" after two-week overlap and notify support. (Owner: Marco / Samir)

Cost-telemetry sync with billing (Thu 2026-03-12)
- Jin provided mapping table for customer_id -> billing_account; need a daily join job to enrich token-cost metrics.
- Short-term: create a dashboard showing cost by deployment_type (hosted / dedicated / private) and top 10 models by spend. Samir to own.
- Long-term: propose automated recommendations for route-level batching and quantization profiles to reduce cost (tracked in OBS-398).

Open issues / Blockers:
- OBS-398: Final schema for cost telemetry (dimensions and cardinality) — waiting on billing team for extra columns. Blocker for Samir's enrichment job.
- Production canary dependency: need a minor runtime config change that infra team owns (infra ticket INF-904). Could delay canary by 24-48h.
- Dashboard backlog: 8 small items (annotations, variable defaults, cross-filtering) are blocking support onboarding. We need 2 sprint-days to clear.

Metrics / Observability KPIs this week:
- Trace ingestion volume: -25% on staging after sampling policy; target -20% -> good.
- P99 trace latency for ingestion pipeline: 210ms (baseline 185ms) — temporary bump attributed to retention patch; monitoring.
- Number of alert noise incidents: decreased from 12/day -> ~2/day post-tuning.
- Preliminary per-token cost: Dedicated pools ~68% of spend, Hosted routes ~22%, Private ~10%. (Samir dashboard)

Action items / Owners:
- Aisha: Run production canary for websocket/api-gateway (10% traffic, 48h) once INF-904 is resolved. Linked: OBS-412.
- Eleni: Complete PR for cached trace TTL change and add regression test (GH: redwood/observability#182). Due: 2026-03-18.
- Marco: Merge tag-normalization PR (#178) and schedule retirement of obs-legacy dashboards. Due: 2026-03-20.
- Samir: Build cost-by-deployment dashboard and start daily billing join job prototype. Due: 2026-03-22. Linked: OBS-398.
- Jin (SRE/billing): Provide final schema fields for billing join and approve access to billing table. Due: 2026-03-19.

Notes / context / links:
- Slack thread: #obs-tracing (see pinned message for canary plan)
- Confluence: OBS-Team-Runbook -> tracing section updated with sampling guidelines.
- Jira: OBS-412 (sampling rollout), OBS-398 (cost-telemetry schema)
- PRs: redwood/observability#178 (tag normalization), #182 (TTL patch), #176 (dashboard templates)

Risks / mitigation:
- If INF-904 is delayed >48h, we will run a limited canary on a single region only to gather early data.
- High cardinality in cost telemetry could blow up prometheus ingestion costs — mitigate by pre-aggregating per-customer daily counters and storing raw join tables in BigQuery. (Samir / billing)

Plan for next week:
- Complete production canary and evaluate coverage metrics.
- Finish dashboard migration and announce retirement schedule to support.
- Prototype daily billing join; publish first cost-by-deployment dashboard.
- Clean up alert rules and add runbook entries for recurring spikes at 03:00 UTC.

Quick wins / FYI:
- Staging sampling reduced trace volume more than expected w.o. loss of debug signal — strong win for rollout.
- Eleni's alert tuning removed a noisy alert that was waking up support multiple times a day.

End of notes.
